title: Fans Choose Ha*Ash’s ‘¿Qué Le Pongo?’ as Best New Latin Music of the Week
summary: The track generated more than 61% of the vote in the latest Billboard New Music Latin poll.
contentText:
Ha*Ash has topped Billboard’s new music Latin poll published on July 10 with “¿Qué Le Pongo?”

In reaction the weekly New Music Latin poll and playlist, curated with recommendations by Billboard Latin and Billboard Español editors, music fans voted for the Mexican duo’s new tune as their favorite music release of the week.

“¿Qué Le Pongo?,” which loosely translates to “what should I reply,” generated more than 61% of the vote , beating out other releases including Feid’s “A Xon de Que,” De La Rose and Ryan Castro’s “La Monda,” Pablo Alborán’s “Tiempos Bonitos,” Banda MS’ “Tu Falta de Querer” and Muchacho Alegre , Luis R. Conriquez’s latest studio album. 

Penned by the sister duo Ashley Grace and Hanna Nicole, the heartfelt country-tinged pop ballad is about someone who receives a text message from an ex-partner, and debates on whether to reply, making it a relatable and contemporary song. 

“¿Qué le pongo para que no piense que sigo extrañandolo?” (“What should I reply so they won’t think I still miss them?”), goes part of the lyrics. The playful music video shows the two sisters driving a vintage pickup truck.

Other fan favorites in this week’s New Music Latin poll— following Ha*Ash’s winning track — are La Cassandra and Martox’s “Paraíso”; Feid’s “A Xon de Que”; “Un Cafecito” by Legado 7; and Edgardo Nuñez’s “Bendecido.” See the full poll results below.
